category: usenet provider (unlimited flat, bundled reader and search)

free_tier.stated: No free tier and no trial stated on the access page; one paid monthly plan.

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap is published; retrieval is by Usenet article over NNTP
per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: 6677 days of binary retention plus several years of text retention

egress.terms: Unlimited download volume and unlimited download speed

interface_detail: NNTP with free SSL; the vendor says any newsreader on any platform works
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: One monthly plan with no minimum term; it can be cancelled at any time, so it suits a month of deep-retention fill behind another provider.
limits_note: USD 10.99 a month, billed month to month; payment logos shown on the page include PayPal, Bitcoin and card brands.
binding_note: Volume and speed are unlimited, so the 30-connection ceiling is the only technical bound stated.

reliability_note: Backbone is not stated on the page read; the vendor states 99%+ completion, which is unmeasured here.
